title: S-AI-Recursive: Convergent Recursive Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.13872v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This article introduces S-AI-Recursive, a bio-inspired Sparse Artificial Intelligence architecture in which reasoning is implemented as a hormonally regulated closed-loop iteration rather than a single feed-forward pass. The Recursive Reasoning Cycle (RRC) is governed by two recursive hormones: Clarifine, a convergence signal, and Confusionin, a residual-uncertainty signal. Their antagonistic interaction regulates state refinement, stopping, resource allocation, and recursive-engram retrieval. The revised framework distinguishes hormonal-subsystem stability from joint cognitive state-hormone convergence and gives explicit sufficient conditions for coupled contraction on fixed-point-structured tasks. It also includes Lyapunov analysis, conditional entropic contraction, multi-signal stopping, Euler-Maruyama discretization with projection, constrained agent selection, and warm-start memory. tldr: 本文提出了一种基于激素调节闭环迭代的稀疏人工智能架构，通过两种递归信号的拮抗作用实现收敛推理，并给出了耦合收缩的充分条件和多种理论分析工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a bio-inspired sparse AI architecture with hormone-regulated closed-loop iterative reasoning, achieving convergent inference through antagonistic recursive signals and providing sufficient conditions for coupled contraction on fixed-point tasks.
